gloss: farewell letter; written last words; suicide note

definitions.gloss: farewell letter; written last words; will
definitions.explanation: A document left behind by a deceased person, expressing their final wishes, instructions, or messages to the living.
A note or letter left behind by a person who has taken their own life.

examples.japanese: {遺書|いしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{残|のこ}す→書き残す：21145_kakinokosu⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺書|いしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A farewell letter from my grandfather was found.

examples.japanese: {遺書|いしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つづられて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The letter was full of words of thanks to the family.

notes:
{遺書|いしょ} is any final written message left by someone who has died, including personal letters and suicide notes. A will in the legal sense, dealing with property, is ⟦{遺言|ゆいごん}→遺言：10896_yuigon⟧ or, formally, {遺言書|ゆいごんしょ} (lawyers read ⟦{遺言|いごん}→遺言：19084_igon⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺書|いしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a farewell letter
- {遺書|いしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a farewell note
- {遺書|いしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: a note is found
